comment: COMEDOR -> WIRE2, 2026-11-08. Plate fractions of assets/art/comedor/comedor-room.png (832x1248, the clean plate from accepted 992300). Camera: tool/art/rooms/comedor.json (horizon .27, eye 1.0 adult); measured on the paint: the far wall's foot at y .394 (s 5.23), the table cloth's foot at y .437 (s 3.61). Proposals; WIRE2 may move marks, but keep them on 'floor'.

floorCamera.note: Standing adult height at foot y = (y - 0.27) / 1.0, as a fraction of plate height. Mācron at heroHome is about 45 logical px, the salon's size.

floor.note: Floor is everything below the far wall's foot (y .394), minus the table: x .198-.763, y .35-.437 (cloth to the floor). The niche's plinth sits on the wall at x .17-.23.

occluder.note: The table's front: cloth from its front edge (y .37) to the floor. The table top above .37 is left out on purpose, because the diners' hands, spoons and bowls are in their own layers there.

exit.note: Mācron hops the polka right, round the table's right end, to the service door (leaves x .751-.841, top .218, foot .394, round window, brass plate). The waiters' line for the outro is waitersOutro.

diners.note: Eight seats behind the table on its far side, facing the room ('at' is the floor under each chair, hidden by the table). Drawn in place on the plate (tool/art/rooms/inplace.py), so each atlas is 1:1 with the plate when its anchor sits at 'at'. Candelabra stand at x .395 and .62.

waiters.note: The staff line: junior waiters hop the polka behind Don Charolas, outside the quiet box (x .35-.65). All behind his mark, so he stays the nearest adult. waiter-b moved from (.76,.47) to (.66,.455): Mācron's exit passed behind it (WIRE2's stills, beat 15).

life.note: Room life at full party: tool/art/rooms/layers/comedor.json, rects in art_runs/rooms/comedor/layers-level.json. Glow marks for a candle flare: chandeliers (.21,.17) and (.80,.17); candelabra (.39,.335) and (.62,.335).

lateGuests.note: One standing late guest in evening dress, a reused atlas (salon cast), by the right wall. With 8 diners and 3 waiters she makes the crowd 12.
